title: Harrison Beverage chosen as a representative
description: Vinalhaven's published town history records that Harrison Beverage of North Haven was chosen as a representative in 1859 and later resigned; Lewis Leadbetter was elected in his place at a December special meeting.
evidence_status: Documented in a published 1889 town history

title: Hiram Beverage builds the Mill Stream dam
description: Two independent local-history accounts identify Hiram “Hightie” Beverage as the builder of the present Mill Stream dam in 1932. The resulting brackish pond became known locally as Hightie's Pond and later supported oyster aquaculture.
evidence_status: Corroborated by two independent local-history accounts; town or engineering record still sought
